name: defect-disposition-ledger
description: Authors this cycle's defect-dispositions.json in full — one entry per inherited defect id, FIXED with single-string resolvable evidence or DEFERRED with a reason — plus a coverage report reconciled against the continuation manifest or registry binding.
when_to_use: Select whenever this lane inherits defects from an ancestor cycle (a continuation manifest or a continuation-registry lane-scope binding exists), especially after any audit that reported disposition-preflight MISSING or INCOMPLETE.
